channel.title: Ukiyoe Edo Life
channel.desc: On those hot, humid summer nights, nothing can get in the way of sleep like mosquitoes on the hunt. We learn about the tools the Edo townspeople had at their disposal to fight the pesky insects.\n\n*\"Woman beside a Mosquito Net,\" from the series \"Starlight Frost and Modern Manners\" (c.1819) by Utagawa Kunisada.
